items.title: Swiss F-35A on track: First components will be manufactured in Italy
items.source: Swiss Federal Office for Defence Procurement armasuisse
items.excerpt: Swiss authorities report the first Swiss F-35A fuselage section and wing are being manufactured at Leonardo's Cameri plant. Cameri is Europe's only F-35 final assembly line, has capacity for up to 20 aircraft per year, and produces about one-third of F-35 wings.

items.title: Initial operating capability of MH-139 Grey Wolf announced
items.excerpt: The U.S. Air Force says the MH-139 Grey Wolf achieved Initial Operational Capability on Aug. 10. The MH-139 is based on Leonardo's AW139 commercial platform; Boeing integrates mission-specific military systems. The Air Force reports nearly 50% higher speed and twice the troop capacity versus UH-1N.
items.query: MH-139 Grey Wolf initial operational capability Leonardo AW139 August 2026

items.title: Woodward Plays a Role in a Milestone Moment for Aviation
items.category: 航空機エンジン・部品
items.excerpt: Woodward supported GE Aerospace's first transoceanic flight of a hybrid-electric powered Saab 340 with an electric-motor-driven glycol cooling pump co-developed at Niles and Rockford. Woodward also supplies the HMU for the standard CT7 turboprop in the aircraft's second engine position.
items.query: Woodward aerospace hybrid electric Saab 340 August 2026

items.title: The 2026 Functional Verification Study: Evidence of a New Verification Operating State
items.excerpt: Siemens EDA published results from its 2026 Functional Verification Study with Wilson Research Group. Siemens reports first-silicon success among IC/ASIC respondents fell to 5% in 2026 from 14.4% in 2024, framing verification complexity, methodology and automation as a worsening engineering bottleneck.
items.query: Siemens EDA functional verification study September 8 2026

items.title: GE Aerospace to Acquire Consolidated Precision Products (CPP), Expanding Mission-Critical Castings Capacity
items.excerpt: Discovery candidate: GE Aerospace agreed to acquire CPP for $11.75B. CPP has ~6,600 employees across 20+ facilities and produces investment and precision-sand cast superalloy, titanium and other complex aerospace castings. GE cites casting capacity, airfoil manufacturing and design-manufacturing integration as strategic drivers.
items.query: GE Aerospace Consolidated Precision Products CPP casting September 8 2026

items.title: SimScale opens Engineering AI agent to its global community
items.excerpt: Discovery candidate: SimScale opened its Engineering AI agent to a community of 900,000+ users. The company says the agent runs a full simulation workflow from CAD cleanup and simulation setup through an output report. Its focus on AI-native CFD/FEA/electromagnetics/thermal workflows gives it strong ongoing watch value.
items.query: SimScale Engineering AI agent August 18 2026 CAE

items.title: Introducing Cast Ingot: Expanding SeAH’s Superalloy Capabilities
items.excerpt: Discovery candidate: SeAH's Temple facility is moving toward nickel- and cobalt-based superalloy cast-ingot production for aerospace, power and advanced foundries. The site couples manufacturing with in-house chemistry, metallography, microstructure and materials-characterization capability, making it relevant for turbine-material supply monitoring.
